status_legend.in_progress: Currently the active task. Only one feature may have this status.
status_legend.blocked: Cannot continue until the documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Required verification passed and evidence is recorded.
status_legend.unsure: Status not determinable from the documents; needs git history / Stage 3 analyze to confirm.

features.title: Add a task
features.user_visible_behavior: User submits a task title via the frontend form; the task is saved to SQLite and appears in the task list without a page refresh.
verification: pytest passes for POST /tasks endpoint (creates a task and returns 201 with task JSON)
Task persists after server restart (GET /tasks returns it on next boot)
Frontend form submits and new task appears in the list

features.title: Edit a task
features.user_visible_behavior: User clicks a task to edit its title inline; the updated title is saved and reflected immediately in the list.
verification: pytest passes for PATCH /tasks/{id} endpoint (updates task title, returns 200 with updated task JSON)
Editing a non-existent task returns 404
Frontend reflects the updated title without a page refresh

features.title: Delete a task
features.user_visible_behavior: User clicks a delete button on a task; the task is removed from the list and from the database permanently.
verification: pytest passes for DELETE /tasks/{id} endpoint (removes task, returns 204)
Deleting a non-existent task returns 404
Frontend removes the task from the list immediately after deletion

features.title: Mark a task complete / incomplete
features.user_visible_behavior: User clicks a checkbox on a task to toggle its completion state; the visual styling updates immediately (e.g. strikethrough for completed tasks).
verification: pytest passes for PATCH /tasks/{id} endpoint toggling the completed boolean (returns 200 with updated task JSON)
Toggling a non-existent task returns 404
Frontend checkbox reflects the correct state and applies completed styling

features.title: Persistence — tasks survive server restarts
features.user_visible_behavior: All tasks (titles, completion states, due dates) are present after the uvicorn server is stopped and restarted; no data is lost.
verification: pytest passes confirming SQLite DB file is used (not in-memory)
Create tasks, restart uvicorn, GET /tasks returns all previously created tasks
DB file exists on disk at expected path after first run

features.title: Filtering and sorting
features.user_visible_behavior: User can filter the task list to show All / Active / Completed tasks, and can sort by creation order or due date using UI controls.
verification: pytest passes for GET /tasks?filter=active, GET /tasks?filter=completed, GET /tasks?sort=due_date endpoints (or equivalent query params)
Frontend filter buttons update the displayed list correctly
Sort by creation order and sort by due date both produce correctly ordered lists

features.title: Due dates with overdue highlighting
features.user_visible_behavior: User can set an optional due date on a task; incomplete tasks whose due date is in the past are visually flagged (e.g. red text or background) in the task list.
verification: pytest passes for POST /tasks and PATCH /tasks/{id} with optional due_date field (ISO 8601 string, nullable)
GET /tasks response includes due_date field for each task
Frontend renders a date picker or input for due date
Overdue incomplete tasks display a distinct visual style compared to non-overdue tasks
